tip: Drink at least 8 glasses of water daily to stay hydrated, maintain energy levels, and support healthy digestion.
Aim for 7 to 9 hours of quality sleep each night to help your immune system repair and recharge.
Take a 30-minute brisk walk every day to boost heart health, improve mood, and strengthen muscles.
Include a variety of colorful fruits and vegetables in your meals for essential vitamins and antioxidants.
Follow the 20-20-20 rule: every 20 minutes screen time, look at something 20 feet away for 20 seconds to prevent eye strain.
Keep your back straight and shoulders relaxed while working at your desk to reduce neck and back pain.
Practice 5 minutes of deep breathing exercises when feeling stressed to calm your nervous system.
Wash your hands thoroughly with soap for at least 20 seconds before eating and after returning home.
Apply sunscreen with SPF 30 or higher when going outdoors during peak daylight hours.
Reduce sodium and processed foods in your diet to support healthy blood pressure levels.
